description: Ready-to-use culture media plates, tubes, and bottles for clinical microbiology laboratories. Covers aerobic, anaerobic, and selective media for pathogen isolation and identification.
Antibiotic susceptibility discs, MIC test strips, and panels compliant with EUCAST and CLSI standards for accurate resistance profiling.
Real-time and conventional PCR kits for detection of infectious diseases including hepatitis, HIV, HPV, respiratory pathogens, and STIs.
Reverse-hybridization strip-based assays for genotyping and mutation detection. Gold standard in pharmacogenetics and hereditary disease screening.
Bacteriophage-based biocontrol products that target and eliminate specific foodborne pathogens on food surfaces without chemicals, antibiotics, or impact on taste.
High-quality antibodies, antigens, and enzymes for IVD test kit manufacturing. Used by diagnostics companies worldwide to build immunoassays.
Reagents that eliminate matrix interference, reduce background noise, and stabilize immunoassay components for ELISA, lateral flow, and CLIA development.
